nodes.description: owner: privileged address set in Owned constructor, used by onlyOwner modifier
newOwner: pending owner address used in two-step ownership transfer
symbol: token ticker string set to 'HBV' in constructor
name: token name string set in constructor
decimals: token decimals set to 2 in constructor
_totalSupply: total token supply assigned to deployer in constructor
balances: mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom
allowed: nested mapping of allowances, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances
safeAdd(uint a, uint b): overflow-checked addition helper
safeSub(uint a, uint b): underflow-checked subtraction helper
safeMul(uint a, uint b): overflow-checked multiplication helper
safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division helper with zero check
Owned(): constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner sets pending newOwner
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then finalizes ownership
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access gate
HBVToken(): constructor that mints full supply to a fixed address
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits to
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender]
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): allowance-based transfer
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns remaining allowance
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approve then external callback
fallback(): payable fallback that reverts all plain ETH transfers
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner external token sweep
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) made after allowance state write
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract
a: first operand of the SafeMath helper functions
b: second operand of the SafeMath helper functions
c: arithmetic result computed and returned by the SafeMath helpers
tokenOwner: address whose balance or allowance is queried
spender: address granted an allowance
to: recipient address of a token transfer
tokens: amount of tokens moved or approved
from: source address in transferFrom
_newOwner: candidate address for pending ownership
data: arbitrary calldata forwarded to receiveApproval
tokenAddress: arbitrary contract address targeted by transferAnyERC20Token
